breakdown.description: The prompt describes a 2D dam break case but configures the front and back boundaries as 'wall' with 'noSlip', which imposes a viscous boundary layer and makes the flow inherently three-dimensional, violating the 2D assumption.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that a 2D simulation in OpenFOAM requires the front and back patches to be of type 'empty'. It explicitly instructed to set 'frontAndBack' patches to type 'empty' in 'system/blockMeshDict' and also set the boundary type to 'empty' for all relevant field files (U, p_rgh, alpha.water), which is the correct way to model a 2D case and avoids the incorrect 3D 'wall' with 'noSlip' condition.
